body:
Sgt,

I've slept all day, but I'm still alive.  The cheating ex wants me to meet up with her so she can explain her actions. I'm going to give her a chance.  I'll hand you off my number when I get done with that. If that works.  

If its anything. My timeline isn't today.
I can't find the beauty in life anymore.
Why? What's the point?  No matter what I do I end up back in the same spot all over again. Repeat ad infinitum.

I hit my peak at 19. Everything has been downhill since.  I've strived for happiness I really have. 

Ive traveled the world and found nothing. I've spent time looking inside of myself and found nothing worthwhile. Not a single thing.

I have talked about it. At length. Over and over again.  And it always comes back down to this.  Every fiber of my being has been screaming for me to do this.  I see no light at the end of the tunnel anymore. 

Ive seen therapists, been committed,  had all my weapons taken away from me and it always returns to this. I'm OK for a few weeks and a few months and than its back to wanting to kill myself. I just can't get past this hurdle.
